lead_headline: Villa Tourism Picks Up in Kalkan
lead_deck: Occupancy rates in Kaş and Kalkan have reached 100 per cent
lead_body: Villa tourism has picked up in Kaş and Kalkan. This season, occupancy rates have reached 100 per cent. Tourists are particularly preferring villas in Kalkan and Kaş. The increase in villa tourism is reflecting positively on the region's economy.
